identification.creator: Train
Arranged by Lynsie Jones for Audacious

direction-type.words: Thank you so much for trusting this song in my hands--I swear to God this song got me through so many rough days in middle school
and it's been so nostalgic/fun to arrange it for you! I hope I gave you enough time to learn it before your concert because hearing you sing
this will make my heart sing. Can't wait!!!
